summary: This bill expands the types of practices eligible for conservation program payments to include alternative manure management and composting, aiming to reduce greenhouse gas emissions and improve soil health, and directs the Secretary of Agriculture to prioritize applications that maximize these benefits, especially from small and mid-sized operations.

scores.thoughts: The bill expands existing programs by allowing for increased payment amounts (up to 100% of costs) and advanced payments (at least 50%) for alternative manure management practices. This will likely lead to increased government outlays for these agricultural conservation programs.
